clauses.evidence: every cast pays R-1 W-1; card goes stack -> graveyard
clauses.issue: engine-limit: no priority, so the instant is only cast in its controller's own action window

clauses.clause: Scorching Dragonfire deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
clauses.evidence: target slot (cast): 1..1 of [you_bear, you_giant, opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant] (all creatures; no player, no noncreature). [cast targets=['you_giant']]: 'you_giant is dealt 3 damage', damage 0 -> 3, it survives; same for opp_giant. Atom = `parse` B5b-named-damage. The planeswalker half is not on the standard board: pack K_scorching_dragonfire_planeswalker_and_scope_ends.json PASSES (Basri Ket targeted, loses its 3 loyalty).

clauses.clause: If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.
clauses.evidence: [cast targets=['you_bear'|'opp_bear'|'opp_flier'|'opp_tapped']]: lethal 3 damage, then 'moves battlefield -> exile (by card/MOVE_ZONE)', never the graveyard. Tree = `parse` B5b-repl-die-exile (no duration node; the executor gives a resolving instant's replacement an end-of-turn lifetime). The later-death and scope parts were NOT_EXERCISED by the trace: pack K_scorching_dragonfire_same_turn_only_that_creature.json PASSES (the targeted 4/4 survives, dies to 1 more damage the same turn -> exile; untargeted opponent's and own creatures dying the same turn -> graveyard), and K_scorching_dragonfire_planeswalker_and_scope_ends.json PASSES (zero-loyalty planeswalker -> exile; a targeted survivor that dies on the next turn -> graveyard).
